text:
Noah Rivera: dropping a quick pass on the latency/throughput card explorations — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/latency-band-v1 Priya Menon: nice iteration. my top two concerns: legend density and the new percentiles toggle (p95/p99) crowd the header at narrower widths Caleb Ortiz: can we collapse the percentile chips into a single control `Percentiles` that expands to a checklist in the flyout? keeps header tidy. Yara Ahmed: +1. but when collapsed the control must expose current selections to screen readers, e.g. "Percentiles: p50, p95" Noah Rivera: agreed. copy proposal for collapsed state: `Percentiles (p50, p95)` displayed, click expands to switches. on mobile show icon + sr-only label. Priya Menon: also looking at the heatmap rendering — users mistake banded rendering for missing tokens when throughput is spiky Caleb Ortiz: suggestion: render banding with a soft gradient between buckets and add a tiny legend entry `Banded = aggregated by sample window` with a ? tooltip linking to docs. Yara Ahmed: microcopy idea: change sampling control from `Show samples` to `Sampling fidelity` with options `Auto / High fidelity / Economy`. "Fidelity" communicates accuracy tradeoffs more directly. Noah Rivera: I like `Sampling fidelity`. default text: `Sampling fidelity — Auto (recommended)`. tooltip: `Auto: dynamically balances accuracy and cost`. Priya Menon: accessibility nit: timepicker presets lose role order on keyboard in the prototype. After opening, TAB goes: preset chips -> calendar field -> fidelity control -> Apply. Expected: preset chips -> calendar -> Apply -> fidelity control Caleb Ortiz: repro steps: 1) Tab to date range button, 2) Enter to open, 3) TAB through chips -> calendar inputs -> focus lands on fidelity before Apply. Happens on Safari and Chrome. Yara Ahmed: filed UX-5812: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-5812 for focus order + SR announcements. Suggest using `aria-flowto` for Apply button in the popover as a temporary fix. UX Lint Bot: Snapshot saved for 1755004321 (latency-band-v1). Lint: ensure collapsed percentile control exposes `aria-expanded` and `aria-label` with selected items. Priya Menon: small code pattern for SR-friendly collapsed control (could inline in React): ```
``` Noah Rivera: agree no visually-hidden hacks. prefer `aria-label` with explicit values. Also add `aria-describedby` on the heatmap for the banding legend id so SRs know what bands mean. Caleb Ortiz: rendering tweak: soften the band edges with a 1px gaussian blur and show a thin outline for zero-sample buckets rather than full transparency. That should stop the "holes" confusion. Yara Ahmed: copy decisions recap: 1) Replace `Show samples` with `Sampling fidelity` and options `Auto / High fidelity / Economy`. 2) Collapse percentile chips into `Percentiles` with selected items read by SRs. 3) Add microcopy under heatmap: `Banded visualization aggregates nearby samples — increase fidelity for raw samples.` 4) Fix timepicker tab order (UX-5812). Priya Menon: also request contrast check on the band legend pill — current gray on light background is borderline. I'll run it through the contrast scanner and post fixes. Noah Rivera: thanks — I'll update the Figma with collapsed percentile states, the fidelity dropdown copy, heatmap banding legend, and the tiny blur overlay. Will share updated frames by tomorrow AM. :sparkles:
